title: Christian Meditations
subtitle: The Golden Book of the True Christian Life
author: John Calvin
description: Five devotional chapters by Calvin on obedience, self-denial, the cross, and the Christian use of the present life.

lessons.title: Humble Obedience
lessons.subtitle: Imitation of Christ and Scripture as the rule

content:
, TRUE IMITATION OF 
CHRIST 
Scripture is the rule of life.

1 Here Calvin inserts: "I am not the person suited to write at length, since I love brevity. It is 
likely that I will attempt it in the future; in any case, I will leave this task to others." 
2 Evidently Calvin here is thinking of 1 Cor. 1–3.
5 Holiness is the key principle
Holiness means total obedience to Christ
External Christianity is not enough.
Spiritual progress is necessary

lessons.title: Self-Denial
lessons.subtitle: We do not belong to ourselves; we belong to the Lord
lessons.summary: We do not belong to ourselves; we belong to the Lord. 10 Seeking the glory of God implies self-denial. Self-denial means sobriety, justice, and devotion.
content: We do not belong to ourselves; we belong to the Lord.

10 
Seeking the glory of God implies self-denial.
Self-denial means sobriety, justice, and devotion.
True humility means respect for others.
We must seek the good of other believers.
We must seek the good of all, friends and enemies.
Good civic conduct is not enough.

17 
There is no happiness without the blessing of God.

18 
We must not be anxious to obtain riches and honors.
The Lord is just in all His acts.

lessons.title: Patience and Bearing the Cross
lessons.subtitle: The cross and spiritual progress
lessons.summary: Bearing the cross is harder than denying oneself. The cross makes us humble The cross makes us hopeful
content: Bearing the cross is harder than denying oneself.
The cross makes us humble
The cross makes us hopeful
The cross teaches us obedience.
The cross contributes to discipline.

25 
The cross brings repentance.

26 
Persecution brings with it the favor of God
27 Persecution should produce spiritual joy
Our cross should not make us indifferent.
The cross is necessary for our submission.
30 The cross is necessary for our salvation

lessons.title: Longing for the World to Come
lessons.subtitle: Hope beyond this world
lessons.summary: We tend to overestimate the present life We should not despise the blessings of this present life. What is the earth compared with heaven?
content: We tend to overestimate the present life
We should not despise the blessings of this present life.
What is the earth compared with heaven?
We should not fear death, but lift up our heads

38 
The Lord will come in His glory: Maranatha
3 This is added in the French version.

39 
A few brief words by way of conclusion

lessons.title: The Right Use of the Present Life
lessons.subtitle: Living with sobriety and devotion
lessons.summary: Earthly things are gifts from God 42 True gratitude will restrain us from committing abuses 43 Let us live with moderation.
content: Earthly things are gifts from God

42 
True gratitude will restrain us from committing abuses

43 
Let us live with moderation.
Let us be patient and content under privations.
Be faithful to your divine calling
